context: A teacher and a teen visit a museum
purpose: Teach: 鎧/ネックレス/文房具/売場/選曲/見どころ/ピアス/葉書

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、戦国時代の鎧、保存状態が良いですね。
lines.en: Sakura, the preservation on this Sengoku-period armor is really excellent.
lines.style: Warm observation, teacher's gentle opening. Not probing—noticing aloud. Soft eye contact, unhurried pace. Creating space for response.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。装飾のネックレス、当時の貴族も着けていたとか。
lines.en: Yes. The decorative necklaces—apparently even the nobility wore them back then.
lines.style: Engaged and specific. A small light in her voice when sharing the detail. Not performing, just genuinely pleased to answer. Quick, natural.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 文房具コーナー、複製品、購入できます。
lines.en: There are replica versions you can buy at the stationery shop.
lines.style: Practical tone, warmly informative. A gentle suggestion, not directive. Conversational pace. Teacher sharing something useful without overstepping.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 子供向け売場、図録、立ち読みしました。
lines.en: I spent some time looking through the guides in the kids' section.
lines.style: Brighter now, a hint of candor—admitting she browsed like a kid herself. Slight smile in the voice. Unselfconscious, natural.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 当時の音楽、選曲、丁寧でしたね、BGMで。
lines.en: The period music they chose for the background was really thoughtful.
lines.style: Reflective, appreciative. Slowing slightly—the kind of observation you make when something small has stayed with you. Genuine, not performative.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 見どころが多くて、時間、足りない。
lines.en: There's so much to see—we're already running out of time.
lines.style: Slight urgency now, animated. Faster pace, a touch of frustration wrapped in brightness. The energy of someone who wants to see everything.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 特別展のピアス展示、現代まで続く美意識を感じますね。
lines.en: The special earring display really shows how that sense of beauty has continued right into the present day.
lines.style: Generous observation, teacher at her best. Thoughtful pace. Drawing a line through time without forcing it. Warm, genuinely moved.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お土産に、当時の風景の葉書、買って帰ります。
lines.en: I'm going to pick up some postcards of period landscapes as a souvenir to take home.
lines.style: Decided and content. Light closing energy—the satisfaction of a good choice. Natural, easy tempo. The conversation finding its natural rest.
